Geographic relocation null (N3)

Source: R/nulls.R
dn_null_relocate.Rd

Null coverage obtained by stamping the species' occupied-cell footprint at random positions on the geographic grid and recomputing coverage from the relocated range. Requires the geographic cell adjacency of the analysis grid; supply project to map relocated geographic cells to environmental scores.

Usage

dn_null_relocate(
  cells,
  grid_dim,
  valid,
  project,
  sp,
  Ze,
  q = 0.95,
  statistic = c("auc", "q"),
  B = 199L,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

cells

integer matrix (n x 2) of occupied geographic cell indices.

grid_dim

geographic grid dimensions c(nrow, ncol).

valid

logical matrix marking terrestrial cells.

project

function taking an (n x 2) cell-index matrix and returning (n x 2) environmental scores (NA rows for cells without climate).

sp

a dn_space.

Ze

(k x P) region densities.

q, statistic, B, seed

as in dn_null_shift().

Value

(k x B) matrix of null coverage values (NA where a relocation could not be placed).

Examples

# Requires a geographic grid and a projection function; sketch:
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
nul <- dn_null_relocate(cells, grid_dim = dim(valid), valid = valid,
                        project = my_lookup, sp = sp, Ze = Ze, B = 99)
} # }
